Top Cote 2 9-1 J Morland Jason Hart 25-1 - - - March foal; 7,000euros foal, 15,000euros yearling; first foal of a 7f 2yo winner (RPR 97), out of French 10.5f winning half-sister to 1m1f Flat and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Authentic Act; others look more likely and he's best watched unless market suggests otherwise. Postcard 2 8-10 A Kirby Sam Hitchcott 25-1 - - 50 1,000gns yearling; 16-1 at Bath (good) three weeks ago and she dropped out before before finishing a remote eighth of ten.

From Me To You didn't live up to market expectations at Newbury but he should know more this time and it wouldn't be a surprise if he took a major step forward. Turnstile showed some promise behind a useful prospect at Thirsk and has claims if he can build on that but there are also several striking newcomers in the line-up. Indian Land and Donegal Rose need a close look, but the vote goes to SKY SECRET who has a lot of speed in his pedigree and represents a yard that won this race last year.[David Moon] Page 1 spotlightleicester 25.04.26

This looks tricky but it might be worth siding with STRIKE RED who is well treated on his second in the Stewards' Cup last August and returned from a break with an a close third at Newcastle 12 days ago. Second choice is Fast Track Harry who has won four of his nine starts and could find more progress back on turf. Fivethousandtoone looks interesting off a lower mark back in this sphere, while Kylian could go well on this step back up in trip and Annaf has claims on his drop back in class.[David Moon] Page 3 spotlightleicester 25.04.26

horses.spotlight_comment: Justcallmepete will be suited by the return to 6f and he doesn't look weighted out of it despite taking a steep rise for his Bath win. The other recent emphatic winner Wreck It Ryley looks to have more to prove and preference is for DAPPER VALLEY (nap) who looked ahead of his mark for his latest win, on the AW in the autumn, and that's certainly the case on his earlier form. Ormolulu and Under The Twilight can also have cases made.[Emily Weber] Page 4 spotlightleicester 25.04.26

Recent AW winner Von Krolock is not expected to fall short on account of the return to turf and he has a good chance following a successful return to 6f last time out. CAMELEY DAYS looks interesting, though, as she was hitting her stride in the autumn and, if her dam's career for this yard is any guide, she should handle good to firm ground and keep improving with racing. Last year's third Starsong is also respected, having resumed in good form on the AW last month.[Emily Weber] Page 5 spotlightleicester 25.04.26

Superior Choice was an eye-catching fourth at Newmarket last autumn and is an interesting contender upped to 1m2f on his reappearance. Act Of Generosity cost 875,000gns as a yearling and is a striking newcomer for Roger Varian, while the other debutant Yafreh also looks the part on paper. However, the vote goes to

An open race in which the vote goes to EVELYN'S PHOENIX who rallied well to score off a reduced mark on his Nottingham reappearance last Saturday. He remains well treated on his best form and is a big player again on this step back up in trip. Dual turf winner Silkies Sib has had productive time on AW since December and he's feared most ahead of Blackwater Lilly, who has been in good form over hurdles recently. Others who could be dangerous are Not So Sobers and Happy Chandler.[David Moon] Page 8 spotlightleicester 25.04.26

Several have possibilities but the vote goes to LION OF MALI who has form figures of 2112 in AW handicaps and is a big player if he can transfer his progress back to turf. Pretty Danielle returned from a break with a close call at Lingfield last month and she's feared most ahead of Circle Of Trust, who ended last season with a near-miss at Yarmouth. Handicap newcomers Chielo and Great Success need a close look in the market, while another to consider Yachtsman.[David Moon] Page 9
